chunks: Put your hand inside your shirt. It will come out white without a tarnish of blame; and do not be perturbed or afraid. These are two proofs from your Lord for the Pharaoh and his nobles. They are certainly a rebellious people.
ai.seo_question: What are the two miracles of Musa mentioned in this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, these two signs (burhanan) are interpreted not merely as physical miracles but as epistemological proofs addressing the rational skepticism of Pharaoh's court; the 'whiteness of the hand' symbolizes divine clarity emerging from obscurity, while the 'gathering of the wing' represents the consolidation of authority and removal of fear. This verse underscores the theme of divine empowerment for prophetic mission, linking the physical manifestation of truth with the psychological transformation of the prophet from apprehension to confidence.
